paragraphs: So it is cited in Yuhasin. And he is mentioned in [Bava Kamma 117b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.117b.6) in the Pesaro printing; and he was the colleague of Rabbi Elazar. But our reading has Rabbi Shimon ben Elyakim.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara names Rabbi Shimon ben Elyakim alongside Rabbi Elazar ben Pedat as judges in this matter. Hyman cites Yochanan from Yuchasin and the Pesaro printing. Those exact witnesses remain uncollated here.
